title: Trial 1
description: Convince Ella that their firstborn is going to be called Gioacchino Maria in memory of Luigi's grandpa. It has to look like you are really fond of that name! You are allowed to ask Camilla for help.

title: Trial 2
description: Make Luigi take 40 pictures with you in multiple parts of the garden, different poses. He must not know about this task.

title: Trial 3
description: Convince your own mom that right after the honeymoon you and Luigi are moving abroad to New York. She must believe it for at least 3 minutes. Bonus point if she starts crying.

title: Trial 4
description: Ask every mother present for ONE piece of marriage advice. Write them all down. Funniest one earns the giver a big kiss and picture of you two!

title: Trial 5
description: Convince the table that you and Luigi already got married in secret at the comune last month and tonight is just to please the families. Camilla is allowed to back you up.

title: Trial 6
description: Show 30 pictures of you and Luigi to Francesco saying he must see them!

title: Trial 7
description: Without letting Gio know, make him take 10+ min of pictures with Anita because 'you didn't get the right angle'.

title: Trial 8
description: Announce to the moms that you have cancelled the honeymoon to use the money for a bathroom renovation. Sell it dead serious. Hold the line for 3 minutes.

title: Trial 9
description: Recite from memory: Luigi's full name, both his parents' names, both sets of grandparents, and the town his family is from. No phone.

title: Trial 10
description: Convince Annamaria that you are pregnant. You really have to sell it! You also must tell her you fear saying it to Luigi because of how he should react.

title: Trial 11
description: Convince Annamaria that Luigi has secretly always wanted a back tattoo of her name and face as a wedding surprise. Show her a picture of the fake tattoo he's planning to make. Show a fake screenshot of the tattoo studio booking if needed. Camilla can help you saying she also tried dissuading him.

title: Trial 12
description: Make a heartfelt toast to Annamaria thanking her for raising Luigi, but slip in 3 absurd lies about him she has to publicly deny on the spot.

title: Trial 13
description: Get Annamaria to show you baby photos of Luigi from her phone. Keep the conversation going until she has shown at least 5.

title: Trial 14
description: Convince Annamaria that you want her — not your own mom — to walk you in for the cake cutting. Watch the table reaction in silence.

title: Trial 15
description: Pick one mother (not yours, not Annamaria) and convince her you have chosen her to read a letter at the ceremony. She must start drafting it out loud.
